turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Good afternoon, this is Neha from Udaan Credit Finance, this call is recorded. Am I speaking with Mr. Imran Khan?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Thank you. Could you confirm the last four digits of your loan account for verification?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Thank you. Your two-wheeler loan EMI of three thousand one hundred rupees is due on the fifth. How would you like to pay?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: I already paid it two days ago through UPI. Why are you calling me?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Sir, our system shows it is still pending. Please make the payment today.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: This is the third time someone from your company has called me this week. I told you I have already paid!

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Sir, the payment is not reflecting, so you need to pay to avoid charges.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: This is ridiculous. I am not paying twice. I am fed up with these calls, stop calling me!

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Don't tell me to calm down. I want to speak to your manager right now.
